about: rasya-taste-v4 nav library: the page's header.nav, dealt by scripts/nav.mjs from the library's twelve archetypes (assets/navs/nav-<id>.html, navs.css, navs.js) and, at about 15% of the pool together, the kit's own four (nav-mega, nav-cards, nav-centre, nav-split: system.css and starter.html). It replaces the nav field of the one-liner. Rules: references/navs.md. kinds: software, gaming, tech (hardware), product, service, place, editorial. mood: calm, crisp, playful, editorial (the button moods). scroll: the behaviours navs.js runs (data-nav-scroll) and the classes they set on the header. mobile: the designed phone menu (data-nav-menu). element: the one brand-world element (data-nav-element), its type, what it is and the prompt the dealer prints. needs: what the page must have (hero: the dealt hero ids it may sit over; has: values that must be in --has; page: a plain condition). heroes.best weighs up, heroes.avoid weighs down. kitEquivalent: the kit nav closest in shape, passed to buttons.mjs and footers.mjs as --nav.

contract.scroll: data-nav-scroll on the header: section, solid, hide, pill
contract.menu: data-nav-menu on the header: takeover, sheet, dock
contract.current: aria-current="location" on the link of the section on screen
contract.kit: a kit nav dealt by nav.mjs carries data-nav="nav-mega|nav-cards|nav-centre|nav-split", no data-nav-menu, and one data-nav-element

library.name: ruled cell bar
library.type: sans 14px links, the name 28px in the display face (2x)

scroll.text: section-aware: the cell of the section on screen fills and takes the accent line along its foot; the bar never hides (it is the grid's first row)

library.mobileText: a full-screen takeover on the inverse ground: ruled rows, numbered, the display face at 32 to 48px; the main action as the end cell at the bar's height

element.what: the ruled cells: 1px rules on the page's column lines (the links start on the line of column 3), the action as the end cell
element.prompt: the rules are the element: keep the links on the line of column 3 and draw the same lines down the hero or the first section (a split, a code panel, a table), so the bar reads as the page's first row; nothing else brand-like in the bar

library.cta: the end cell at the bar's full height with the drawn arrow; a job other than the hero's (Get an API key beside Start building)

needs.page: a page built on the 12 columns, ideally with a visible line or a split under the bar

library.name: split nav, centred wordmark
library.type: sans 13px links, the name 30px in the display face (2.3x), tracked capitals optional

scroll.text: wordmark to symbol: past the hero the word folds away, the symbol moves to the centre line and the hairline comes in; over a photograph it turns from no ground to the page ground

library.mobileText: the name left, the menu right; a full-screen takeover, the words in the display face at 32 to 48px

element.what: the brand's symbol beside the centred name (the client's own symbol, else the dealt .mark), the one shape that stays when the word folds
element.prompt: use the client's own symbol (its logo's mark without the word); without one, the dealt mark (start.mjs) in the accent; it is the one thing left in the bar's centre past the hero

library.cta: a pill with the drawn arrow, a job beside the hero's (Book a site visit beside Start a house)

needs.page: a name of 12 characters or fewer that sets well at 30px; over a photo hero add data-nav-over and data-nav-tone

from: Legora (split over a photograph, serif capitals)

library.name: transparent to solid over media
library.type: 18px bold links over the photograph, the name 32px heavy

scroll.text: transparent to solid: no ground over the photograph, the page ground and ink past the hero; hides going down, back going up

library.mobileText: solid from the top (the kit's photograph sits under the bar under 1024); a full-screen takeover

element.what: the local time where the photograph is (data-nav-clock, kept live by navs.js), or one real fact of the place: the season you can book, the lead time
element.prompt: pick one real datum from the brief: the town the product is made in or the place stands in, with its IANA time zone for data-nav-clock (Tórshavn, Atlantic/Faroe); or the season, the lead time or the stock the brief states. Never coordinates or a street number (house rule 9)

alt.what: a season or a lead time from the brief

library.cta: the page's filled action in a pill with the arrow; it reads on the photograph and on the ground

needs.page: a full-bleed photo hero (hero-photo) whose top 120px at 1440 is calm and dark (or light, with data-nav-tone="dark"); no scrim

from: Huts (transparent over video, cream on scroll)
On (big bold words over the photograph)

library.name: collapse to pill

scroll.text: collapse to pill: open across the .wrap at the top, a centred capsule on the surface once the page moves; never hides

library.mobileText: always the capsule; the menu a rounded sheet under it on the surface, the page dimmed, the words in the display face at 32px

element.what: a chip in the capsule: the days to a real date of the brief (data-nav-countdown: an ISO date, or monthly:<day>), a rating, a price
element.prompt: pick one real datum from the brief for the chip: a date it counts down to (pay day, a launch, a delivery cut-off: data-nav-countdown), a store rating, a price; with none, use the alternative

alt.what: the capsule filled with the brand colour (its words in the accent's ink, the action on the page ground)

library.cta: the accent action with the drawn arrow; a job beside the hero's (Get the app beside Open an account)

needs.page: four or five short words; the top 72px of the hero on a quiet ground

from: Yummygum (full bar to a centred pill)
Wimp Decaf (the bar in the bag colour)

library.name: bottom dock
library.type: mono caps 12px in the dock, the name 28px at the top

scroll.text: dock: the dock stays; past the hero the top row folds away and the dock takes the action; the segment of the section on screen fills

library.mobileText: under 640 the dock holds the menu button and the action, 12px clear of the screen's edges; the sheet rises out of it with the words in the display face at 32px

element.what: the dock itself: an accent tile with the mark and the words as mono segments on the inverse ground
element.prompt: the tile carries the client's mark (else the dealt one) on the accent; keep four short words (eight letters or fewer) so the dock stays one control

library.cta: mono caps, at the top until the hero ends, then at the dock's end

needs.page: three to five sections; never a place (its action bar holds the foot); no nav.actionbar

from: Toormix (bottom dock, yellow tile, grey mono segments)

library.name: mono utility strip

library.mobileText: a rounded sheet under the bar, the words in the display face at 32px, the actions floating at the foot

element.what: the label type and the path after the logo, "/ section", that follows the section on screen (data-nav-path)
element.prompt: use it only when mono already speaks on the page (eyebrows, specs, code, a label); the path's first word is the page's own (overview, the product's name); nothing else in the bar is mono-decorated

library.cta: mono caps with the drawn arrow, a job beside the hero's (Start free beside Connect a repo); Sign in as a tinted chip

library.mobileText: the name left, the menu right; a full-screen takeover, the words at 32 to 48px

element.what: the local time where the studio works or the product is made (data-nav-clock), kept live
